text:
sara: Thinking about a preview-first rollout model for runtime config changes. Idea: every change creates a preview endpoint + dry-run telemetry so owners can smoke-test before any live activation. Thoughts?
liam: Love it. Main risks: preview divergence and confidence signals. How do we ensure preview behavior matches production?
anjali: We can shadow 1% of live traffic into the preview env with request headers toggled. That gives real inputs without changing outputs.
mike: Shadowing is fine but need cost guardrails. Also we should avoid caching effects in preview that differ from prod. Maybe a toggle to disable cache in preview.
sara: Exactly. UX: console shows a "Preview snapshot" button next to config diffs, which spins up a read-only preview id. Copy of effective config + a replayable traffic sample.
liam: For APIs: propose `POST /v1/configs/{id}/previews` -> returns preview_id and a signed preview_url. Example response: ```json
{"preview_id":"pv_2024_06_01_01","preview_url":"https://preview.redwood/proxy/pv_2024_06_01_01"}```
anjali: Telemetry: emit `config.preview.created`, `config.preview.shadow_rate`, `config.preview.eval.metrics` with tags (org, config_key, preview_id). Also sample request/response hashes to detect difference.
mike: We'll need an automated divergence checker that runs sampled inputs through prod and preview and reports any semantic differences above a threshold. Output could be a daily report.
sara: UX: flag any preview with >0 divergences as "needs attention" and prevent auto-promotion. Promotion should be explicit `promote` action.
liam: Rollout flow idea: 1) preview; 2) shadow 1% for 24h; 3) staged activation (5, 25, 100) with monitoring gates. Each step must pass lint + divergence checks.
anjali: Monitoring gates: latency percentile regression < 5ms, error rate delta < 0.05%, and semantic divergence < 0.1% for sampled evals. These thresholds configurable per config key.
mike: How do we store preview state? I propose Redis for ephemeral route routing + Postgres row for audit with preview_id, creator, commit_id, and TTL. When preview expires, mark as `expired` in DB.
sara: Security: preview URLs must be signed and expire; only users with `config.preview` permission can create. For Hosted customers we restrict shadowing to org admins unless opted-in.
liam: Console-level UX: show a diff + small "replay" runner that replays a chosen traffic slice. Include a quick histogram of metric deltas. Keep messages small.
anjali: Sampling plan: for privacy, sample only metadata and deterministic hashes, never full payloads. Provide a hashed example and link to on-prem replay infra for customers who want raw replays.
mike: Ops alerting: raise a P1 if staged activation triggers more than 2 divergence alerts within 30 minutes, and auto-rollback if divergence persists.
sara: API contract for promote: `POST /v1/configs/{id}/promote` with body `{preview_id, target_percentage, dry_run:false}`. Promote returns an activation_id.
liam: Add idempotency-key header on promote to avoid double-applies from UI retries. Also require `dry_run:true` for initial stage for automation.
anjali: For dashboards: add "Preview health" card to config dashboard showing active previews, shadow rate, divergence score, and next recommended step.
mike: Implementation TODOs: preview proxy, shadow pipe, divergence checker service, console diff+replay UI, API endpoints, audit table, RBAC checks.
sara: Timeline: prototype in staging this quarter. Proposal: feature-flag to enable preview per org. Start with internal org only.
liam: One blocker: how to test third-party integrations (webhooks) in preview safely? Need a webhook sink toggle that can route to a captured queue or stub.
anjali: Add `webhook_mode` enum on preview: `stub|capture|forward`. Default `stub` to avoid accidental external calls.
mike: Nice. For telemetry names I suggest `config.preview.*` and `config.promotion.*` for clarity. Add `config.divergence.score` gauge.
sara: Great. I'll draft an RFC and include sample API schemas + console mockups.
liam: I'll take the divergence checker prototype.
anjali: I'll work on telemetry schema and sampling rules.
mike: I'll own proxy + shadowing infra and cost estimate.
sara: Thanks. Tagging folks for followups @here. :rocket:
